# Independent fictional document originals

Generated by `node tests/generate-general-document-corpus.mjs` using installed Canvas/jsPDF only. No paid image service, real business documents or model responses are used. These files and the accompanying ground truth are test assets, not provider prompts, application sample-replay answers or admission rules.

| ID | Original | Main coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| G01 | Harbor Cedar supplier invoice | Three items, item discount, VAT, due date, PO and explicit project/department |
| G02 | Paper Kite narrow receipt | Office expense, thermal layout, tax and discounts not printed |
| G03 | Dune Spark receipt | Simulated mobile photograph, slight rotation, paid project expense, explicit zero tax |
| G04 | Blue Fig purchase invoice | JPEG rotated 90 degrees, two VAT-bearing rows |
| G05 | Palm Lantern invoice | Arabic/English text, Arabic digits and decimal separators |
| G06 | Copper Reed PDF | Two pages of selectable text; six rows and final-page totals |
| G07 | Stone Finch scanned PDF | Two raster-only pages; no selectable text; six rows |
| G08 | Juniper Line mixed PDF | Selectable first page plus raster second page, four office-expense rows |
| G09 | Cobalt Arch quotation | Explicitly not an official bill; must remain review only |
| G10 | Willow Cup partial receipt | Simulated low-quality photo; date/reference/subtotal absent and first quantity obscured |

The photographs are deterministic computer-generated simulations, not photographs taken with a physical phone. The Arabic case is bilingual, not an Arabic-only benchmark. All examples visibly identify themselves as fictional QA and not legal tax documents. This corpus does not prove handwritten-document support.

The manifest records original printed figures, row order/count, source document type and supported classification. Empty strings mean absent or deliberately unreadable evidence, never zero. G10's first quantity must remain unknown even though a person could derive it from the printed rate and total. Matching identifiers are absent from the original and remain blank until AZZORA matches authorized records. Office receipts do not print a tax amount; extracting zero would be an unsupported inference.

PDF page count and text/raster status must be verified independently. Render every PDF page and inspect the image originals before paid testing. Current maximum file size is below 2 MB and all PDFs have two pages, within the existing five-page limit.

`tests/general-document-hosted.mjs` is offline by default. Hosted execution requires an immutable Accounts Preview, exact SHA, coordinator-confirmed remaining shared budget, explicit fictional authorization and private authenticated state. It submits actual originals serially, records genuine result fields and uncertainty, distinguishes fresh/cached results, tests review/draft boundaries and captures desktop/mobile screens. It never resets the budget or automatically retries a paid request. Actual provider-billed dollars stay unverified unless separately reconciled; a published-tariff token estimate is not a bill.
